records.jp: ちょっと意外だなー。えへへ！
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm a little surprised.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I'm a little surprised.
records.en: Hehe, I'm a little surprised.

records.jp: 美弦さんはこういうのって、<CR>付き合ってくれないと思ってたもん
records.en_original: I didn't think this kind of thing would interest you, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't think this kind of thing would interest you, Mio.
records.en: I thought you wouldn't go along with something like this,<CR>Mio-san.

records.jp: え？　どうして？
records.en_original: Huh? Why's that?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why's that?
records.en: Huh? Why's that?

records.jp: こんなの子供っぽいって言われちゃうかもって<CR>思って
records.en_original: I feel like you'd say it's childish or something.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like you'd say it's childish or something.
records.en: I thought you might call<CR>something like this childish.

records.jp: じゃあ私も、子供でいいかな
records.en_original: Then I guess you can call me a child.
records.en_auxiliary: Then I guess you can call me a child.
records.en: Then I guess I'm fine being a child too.

records.jp: 子供で……いい？
records.en_original: Call you...a child?
records.en_auxiliary: Call you...a child?
records.en: Call you...a child?

records.jp: 私、七夕のお祭りって素敵だと思うから
records.en_original: Yes, because I love the Tanabata festival.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, because I love the Tanabata festival.
records.en: Because I think the Tanabata festival is wonderful.

records.jp: 七夕のお祈りなんて、合理的じゃないって<CR>いかにも言いそうかなって
records.en_original: I thought you'd say that making a Tanabata wish is irrational or something.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you'd say that making a Tanabata wish is irrational or something.
records.en: I thought you'd be the type to say Tanabata<CR>wishes were irrational.

records.jp: そう……。<CR>私って、そんなに堅物に見えているのね
records.en_original: Is that so... I must really seem uptight.
records.en_auxiliary: Is that so... I must really seem uptight.
records.en: Is that so...<CR>I must really seem uptight.

records.jp: うっ。そ、そういうワケじゃ……
records.en_original: Urk. Th-that's not what I meant...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk. Th-that's not what I meant...
records.en: Urk. Th-that's not what I meant...

records.jp: 冗談。そう振舞っているんだから、そう見えて<CR>当たり前のこと
records.en_original: I'm kidding. That's how I always act, so it's no surprise people would see me that way.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm kidding. That's how I always act, so it's no surprise people would see me that way.
records.en: I'm kidding. That's how I always act,<CR>so it's no surprise people would see me that way.

records.jp: ふ、振舞ってるんだ！？
records.en_original: I-it's just an act?!
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's just an act?!
records.en: You're acting that way!?

records.jp: 実はこうして願い事を捧げるのって、<CR>どきどきする
records.en_original: To be honest, I think making a wish like this is really exciting.
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, I think making a wish like this is really exciting.
records.en: To be honest,<CR>I think making a wish like this is really exciting.

records.jp: うん！<CR>願い事がもし本当に天に届いたら、嬉しいよね！
records.en_original: Me too! I hope our wishes really do come true!
records.en_auxiliary: Me too! I hope our wishes really do come true!
records.en: Yeah!<CR>It would be wonderful if our wishes really reached the heavens!

records.jp: 愛央は、どんなお願い事を書いたの？
records.en_original: What did you write for your wish, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you write for your wish, Ao?
records.en: What did you write for your wish, Ao?

records.jp: うーん。そうだなぁ……
records.en_original: Hmm... Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Well...
records.en: Hmm... Well...

records.jp: そうだ！　お互いのを見せ合いっこしない？
records.en_original: I know! Let's show them to each other at the same time!
records.en_auxiliary: I know! Let's show them to each other at the same time!
records.en: I know! Why don't we show each other what we wrote?

records.jp: え？　いいけど
records.en_original: Huh? Well, sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Well, sure.
records.en: Huh? Well, sure.

records.jp: やったあ！
records.en_original: Yay!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay!
records.en: Yay!

records.jp: ちょっと恥ずかしいかも！
records.en_original: This is kind of embarrassing!
records.en_auxiliary: This is kind of embarrassing!
records.en: This might be a little embarrassing!

records.jp: そんなに恥ずかしいことを書いたの？
records.en_original: How embarrassing could it be?
records.en_auxiliary: How embarrassing could it be?
records.en: Did you write something that embarrassing?

records.jp: そ、そういうわけじゃないけど……
records.en_original: W-well, it's just...
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, it's just...
records.en: W-well, it's just...

records.jp: それなら、見せ合おうか？
records.en_original: How about we show them to each other at the same time?
records.en_auxiliary: How about we show them to each other at the same time?
records.en: How about we show them to each other at the same time?

records.jp: それじゃ、せーの！
records.en_original: Okay. One, two, three!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. One, two, three!
records.en: Okay. One, two, three!

records.jp: 愛央は……『もっとしっかりしたリーダーに<CR>なれますように』
records.en_original: Ao's wish is... "to become a better leader."
records.en_auxiliary: Ao's wish is... "to become a better leader."
records.en: Ao wrote...<CR>'May I become a more dependable leader.'

records.jp: 素敵なお願い。<CR>愛央はもう立派なリーダーだと思うけど
records.en_original: That's a wonderful wish. I think you're already a great leader, though.
records.en_auxiliary: That's a wonderful wish. I think you're already a great leader, though.
records.en: That's a wonderful wish.<CR>I think you're already a great leader, though.

records.jp: 美弦さんは……『大切な人たちが幸せな未来に<CR>行けますように』
records.en_original: Mio wishes for... "a happy future for the people I care about."
records.en_auxiliary: Mio wishes for... "a happy future for the people I care about."
records.en: Mio-san wrote...<CR>'May the people precious to me reach a happy future.'

records.jp: うぅ……スケールがでかい。<CR>自分がちっぽけに思えてきたー！
records.en_original: Guh... These are on completely different scales! I feel so silly now!
records.en_auxiliary: Guh... These are on completely different scales! I feel so silly now!
records.en: Guh... These are on completely different scales!<CR>I feel so silly now!

records.jp: そんなことはないわよ
records.en_original: That's not true.
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true.
records.en: That's not true.

records.jp: だってぇ……<CR>私のお願いなんて、自分のことだけで……
records.en_original: But I only wished for something for myself...
records.en_auxiliary: But I only wished for something for myself...
records.en: But I only<CR>wished for something for myself...

records.jp: あなたのお願いは、みんなのためのお願い。<CR>あなただけのものではない。違う？
records.en_original: You didn't just wish for something for yourself. Your wish was for everyone, wasn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: You didn't just wish for something for yourself. Your wish was for everyone, wasn't it?
records.en: Your wish is for everyone.<CR>It isn't yours alone, is it?

records.jp: （私はなんの取り柄もないから、<CR>そんな願いしか浮かばなかっただけだよ）
records.en_original: (I have nothing else to offer, so that was the only wish that came to mind.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I have nothing else to offer, so that was the only wish that came to mind.)
records.en: (I only thought of that wish<CR>because I have nothing else to offer.)

records.jp: 私、やっぱり美弦さんのお願いには<CR>どこまで行っても追いつけないなぁ
records.en_original: My wishes will never be on your level, no matter what I do.
records.en_auxiliary: My wishes will never be on your level, no matter what I do.
records.en: I can never catch up to your wish,<CR>Mio-san, no matter how far I go.

records.jp: えへ。そ、そうかな
records.en_original: Eheh. Y-you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Eheh. Y-you think?
records.en: Eheh. Y-you think?

records.jp: ええ。気高い願いだと思う
records.en_original: Yes. I think it's a noble wish.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I think it's a noble wish.
records.en: Yes. I think it's a noble wish.

records.jp: （気高いのは、美弦さんの方だよ……）
records.en_original: (Mio's the noble one here...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mio's the noble one here...)
records.en: (Mio-san's the noble one here...)

records.jp: 私も、美弦さんみたいに優しいお願い事、<CR>書けるようになりたいな、なんて！
records.en_original: I wish I could write compassionate wishes like yours!
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I could write compassionate wishes like yours!
records.en: I want to become able to write a kind wish like yours too,<CR>Mio-san!

records.jp: や、優しいなんてこと……
records.en_original: W-was it really that compassionate...?
records.en_auxiliary: W-was it really that compassionate...?
records.en: I-it isn't that kind...

records.jp: （いつか、美弦さんみたいな人になりたいな）
records.en_original: (Someday, I wanna become someone like Mio.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Someday, I wanna become someone like Mio.)
records.en: (Someday, I wanna become someone like Mio-san.)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
